Federal Reserve commentary and December rate decision as inflation remains sticky above target despite oil relief

items.title: Biden says he didn't hide cancer diagnosis
items.feedTitle: Biden says he didn't hide cancer diagnosis while president
items.summary: Former President Biden stated in a recent interview that he did not conceal his stage 4 prostate cancer diagnosis while in office, and said he would not have pursued a second term had he been diagnosed earlier. The disclosure comes as Biden reflects on his political career and the events that shaped his recent exit from the 2024 race. His statement addresses ongoing questions about transparency regarding his health during his presidency.

items.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent moved to military base
items.feedTitle: Bessent moved to military base after Iranian threats
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated from his Washington-area home to a military base due to Iranian threats against his life, according to sources familiar with the situation. Security concerns escalated after media reports about his role in economic pressure campaigns against Iran. Bessent is one of several Trump administration officials now residing on military bases for safety.

items.title: U.S. Army officer arrested in UK for alleged espionage
items.feedTitle: U.S. Army officer arrested in U.K. on suspicion of trying to steal secrets for Russia
items.summary: A senior U.S. Army officer was arrested in the United Kingdom on suspicion of attempting to steal secrets for Russia. Authorities suspect the officer of assisting a foreign intelligence service and obtaining or disclosing protected information. The arrest underscores growing concerns about espionage and national security threats involving U.S. military personnel.

items.title: House votes to end Hegseth impeachment effort
items.feedTitle: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
items.summary: The House effectively ended the effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth with a vote that saw the measure fail to advance. Trump praised Hegseth following the failed impeachment effort, calling him a 'Great American Patriot.' Democrats expressed frustration over the outcome, with some colleagues missing the key procedural vote.

items.title: Swatters increasingly using AI voices for 911 calls
items.feedTitle: Swatters are using AI voices to deceive 911 dispatchers, and it's only getting worse
items.summary: Swatters are using artificial intelligence to create synthetic voices or realistic sound effects to generate convincing fake emergency calls to law enforcement. The technology makes the fake calls increasingly difficult for 911 dispatchers to distinguish from genuine emergencies. Authorities warn the trend is accelerating and poses serious public safety risks.

stlouis.title: BJC Health, St. Luke's announce merger letter of intent
stlouis.feedTitle: BJC Health and St. Luke’s Announce Letter of Intent to Strengthen Health Care Across St. Louis Region
stlouis.summary: BJC Health and St. Luke's health systems announced a letter of intent to combine operations and strengthen healthcare services across the St. Louis region. The proposed merger aims to improve care delivery and coordination across the metro area's major hospital networks. The combination would create a more integrated healthcare system serving the region.

stlouis.title: St. Louis Public Schools to close 9 buildings next year
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis Public Schools to close 9 buildings next school year as board takes restructuring votes
stlouis.summary: St. Louis Public Schools announced plans to close nine buildings during the next school year as part of broader restructuring efforts. The board approved the closures as it addresses facility utilization and operational efficiency. The decision will affect students and staff across multiple school communities.

stlouis.title: Democrats flip Metro East legislature seat, eye another
stlouis.feedTitle: Democrats flipped a Metro East state legislature seat and could win another
stlouis.summary: Democrats successfully flipped a Metro East state legislature seat and are positioned to potentially win another in the region. The wins represent gains for Democrats in what has traditionally been competitive territory. The developments signal shifting dynamics in the St. Louis metropolitan area's political landscape.

items.title: Russia-Ukraine secure major prisoner exchange in talks
items.feedTitle: Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi bring progress on prisoners but not on peace
items.summary: Russia and Ukraine agreed to the 'largest prisoner exchange' of the war following two days of US-brokered talks in Abu Dhabi, though broader peace negotiations made little progress. U.S. envoys are scheduled to meet separately with Putin and Zelenskyy to pursue further diplomatic efforts. The talks represent the first direct negotiations between the warring sides since February.

items.title: Iran refuses to surrender enriched nuclear material
items.feedTitle: Iran War Updates: Iran vows not to part with "single particle of enriched nuclear material" as standoff continues
items.summary: Iran has refused to relinquish any enriched uranium and threatens to strike U.S. bases in Europe if attacked, according to statements from Iranian officials. The standoff continues amid negotiations over Iran's nuclear program and regional tensions. Officials say the ball remains in the U.S. court regarding diplomatic resolution.

items.title: Spain's first general strike in 14 years over housing
items.feedTitle: Millions join Spain’s first general strike in 14 years in protest at rising housing costs
items.summary: Millions of Spaniards participated in the country's first general strike in 14 years to protest soaring housing costs and economic hardship. The 24-hour stoppage drew widespread participation across sectors and cities, coming weeks before parliamentary elections. The strike reflects growing public anger over affordability and the rising political influence of far-right parties.

items.title: Hoax bomb threats hit schools across Europe, UK
items.feedTitle: Thousands of hoax bomb alerts sent to schools in Italy, U.K. and Ireland
items.summary: Over 6,000 schools across Italy, Scotland, and Northern Ireland received suspicious bomb threat emails in a coordinated hoax. Authorities in all three countries said there appeared to be no credible danger to students or staff, though many schools were evacuated as a precaution. The incidents are being investigated as suspected coordinated hoaxes.

items.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient, countdown begins
items.feedTitle: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
items.summary: Kenya discharged its last Ebola patient and began a 42-day countdown toward being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded during that period. The milestone marks major progress in containing the outbreak that emerged earlier this year. Health officials say Kenya will continue prevention measures through December 23.

items.title: India simplifies visa norms, cuts categories to 9
items.feedTitle: India simplifies visa norms; categories cut, forms to be 70% leaner
items.summary: India has rationalized its visa regime by reducing main visa categories from 13 to 9 and trimming application form fields by 65-70 percent. The simplification aims to draw more foreign visitors for tourism, business, and medical treatment. The new streamlined process is intended to make India more accessible and appealing to international travelers and professionals.

items.title: Former Vice President Dhankhar collapses, hospitalized
items.feedTitle: Ex-Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar Collapses During Walk, Hospitalised
items.summary: Ex-Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar collapsed during a morning walk and was admitted to AIIMS Delhi for treatment. The sudden health incident prompted hospitalization for observation and medical evaluation. Details about his condition remain limited pending further updates from hospital authorities.

items.title: Moody's raises India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7%
items.feedTitle: Moody’s Ratings raises India’s GDP growth forecast for current fiscal year to 7% from 6.5%
items.summary: Moody's Ratings increased its forecast for India's GDP growth in the current fiscal year from 6.5% to 7%, signaling confidence in the economy's expansion. The upward revision reflects positive economic indicators and growth momentum. This marks a notable upgrade in the outlook for India's economic performance.

items.title: Bengaluru's Bannerghatta Road metro opens November 14
items.feedTitle: Bengaluru's Bannerghatta Road metro will start public service on Nov 14: Minister
items.summary: Bengaluru's Bannerghatta Road metro station is scheduled to begin public service on November 14, expanding the city's metro network. The minister announced the opening date as the metro extension project nears completion. The new station will improve connectivity in that corridor of the city.

items.title: Tamil Nadu investigates alleged AI-generated library book scam
items.feedTitle: Tamil Nadu: India investigates alleged 'AI scam' involving public library books
items.summary: India's authorities are investigating allegations that AI-generated books were procured for public libraries in Tamil Nadu, potentially amounting to fraud. The Madras High Court directed DVAC to register a formal case and freeze funds related to the library book procurement. The investigation raises concerns about quality control and misuse of AI in public institutions.

immigration.title: IBM ends H-1B, green card sponsorship for consulting
immigration.feedTitle: Is IBM ending H-1B sponsorship? Yes, for most consulting jobs, including green cards
immigration.summary: IBM has discontinued H-1B visa and green card sponsorship for most roles within its 150,000-person consulting division, telling affected workers to relocate abroad or leave the company. The move comes amid Trump administration's tightening of tech immigration policies. The decision follows similar announcements by other major tech firms and signals broader industry retrenchment on visa sponsorships—action taken, not proposed.

immigration.title: H-1B grace period proposal draws 31,000+ public comments
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Administration's Plan to End H-1B Grace Period Draws More Than 31,000 Public Comments
immigration.summary: The Trump administration's proposal to end the H-1B grace period—which allows workers to stay in the U.S. during visa extension processing—has drawn more than 31,000 public comments from concerned workers and employers. The proposal remains pending and has not been finalized. The high volume of comments reflects significant anxiety among Indian IT professionals and sponsoring companies about potential job losses.

immigration.title: U.S. prepares largest mass visa revocation targeting 200,000
immigration.feedTitle: US set for largest mass visa revocation in history targeting up to 200,000 foreigners, officials say
immigration.summary: U.S. officials say the Trump administration is preparing what could be the largest mass visa revocation in history, potentially targeting up to 200,000 foreigners. The planned enforcement action remains in preparation and has not yet been executed. The scale of the proposed revocation represents an unprecedented enforcement operation if implemented.

items.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq rise over 1% as CoreWeave calms AI fears
items.feedTitle: S&P 500, Nasdaq rise over 1% as CoreWeave results calm AI spending jitters
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq indexes gained more than 1% as CoreWeave's strong earnings results eased concerns about AI spending sustainability and capital intensity. Tech stocks rebounded after recent weakness, with Nvidia shares also recovering. The positive earnings report signaled continued demand for AI infrastructure despite earlier market jitters.

items.title: Sensex rallies 773 points, Nifty reclaims 25,250
items.feedTitle: Sensex rallies 772 pts to hit near 9-month high, Nifty closes above 25,250 on FII inflows, low crude
items.summary: India's Sensex jumped 773 points to hit a near 9-month high, while Nifty closed above 25,250, driven by strong foreign portfolio inflows and easing crude oil prices. Banking and automobile stocks led the gains. The rally reflects improved sentiment as oil prices have cooled from earlier highs.

items.title: U.S. inflation rose 0.4% in October, price gains cooling
items.feedTitle: US inflation rose 0.4% in October as price increases cooled and gas costs dipped
items.summary: U.S. inflation increased 0.4% from September to October, slightly above expectations but representing a cooldown as gas costs dipped during the month. The data comes after Republicans' midterm losses, which were partly attributed to voter concerns over high prices. The moderation in price pressures may influence Federal Reserve deliberations on interest rates.

items.title: Oil prices fall to lowest since August on Iran relief
items.feedTitle: Oil prices fall to lowest since August as Trump says Iran war is ‘effectively over’
items.summary: Oil prices fell to their lowest level since late August, with Brent crude dropping below $90 per barrel, as markets reacted with relief to Trump's statement that the Iran war is 'effectively over.' Stock markets climbed higher in response to the easing geopolitical tensions. The price decline reflects reduced near-term risk of broader Middle East escalation.

items.title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion valuation in IPO
items.feedTitle: Anthropic targets valuation of up to $1.4tn in stock market flotation
items.summary: Anthropic is seeking a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion in its imminent stock market flotation, below earlier expectations of $2 trillion as investor sentiment on AI valuations has cooled. The company's IPO roadshow is underway and the offering is reportedly already oversubscribed multiple times over. The valuation adjustment reflects the current market environment's more cautious approach to AI company valuations.

finance.note: U.S. stocks and Indian indexes rallied on easing oil prices (Brent below $90 after Trump's Iran statement) and strong AI earnings from CoreWeave, offsetting inflation concerns from October's 0.4% monthly increase. Global sentiment improved as Anthropic's oversubscribed IPO and robust Chinese equity demand counter tech sector volatility. Watch: Fed decision on December rate hikes, Anthropic's November 19 listing, and whether geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz re-escalate.

cards.title: Sleep consistency beats duration
cards.insight: Maintaining a regular sleep-wake schedule trains your circadian rhythm more effectively than simply sleeping longer on weekends. Even 6.5 consistent hours at the same times daily supports better mood, focus, and immune function than erratic 8–9 hour blocks.
cards.takeaway: Set a fixed bedtime and wake time for 7 consecutive days; track energy and mood shifts by day 5.

cards.title: Stress relief through movement variability
cards.insight: Routine exercise is vital, but varying the type, intensity, and environment—running outdoors one day, yoga the next, swimming the third—engages different neural pathways and prevents adaptation fatigue, amplifying mental health benefits.
cards.takeaway: Rotate three distinct activities (endurance, flexibility, strength) weekly instead of repeating the same workout.

cards.title: Social connection outpaces solitary wellness
cards.insight: A single meaningful conversation or group activity reduces cortisol and anxiety more durably than solo meditation or stress-management apps. Regular in-person connection is among the strongest predictors of longevity and mental resilience.
cards.takeaway: Schedule one recurring weekly activity with a friend or group—coffee, sport, volunteering—and treat it as non-negotiable.

cards.title: Hydration affects mood and cognition faster than diet
cards.insight: Even mild dehydration (1–2% loss of body water) impairs focus, increases irritability, and triggers false hunger signals. Most people feel cognitive and emotional shifts within 20–30 minutes of drinking water, before any food change takes effect.
cards.takeaway: Drink 250 ml (8 oz) of water every 1.5–2 hours; log it for one week to identify your baseline mood-hydration link.

ai.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70–$78 per share
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
ai.summary: Anthropic announced an IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share, implying a valuation of up to $1.404 trillion on a fully diluted basis if shares list at the top of the range. The company is allocating up to 20% of the offering for retail investors and plans to list on November 19. Strong early demand suggests the IPO could see record retail participation.

ai.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaGenome 2 maps DNA cell changes
ai.feedTitle: Google’s AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease
ai.summary: Google DeepMind released AlphaGenome 2, an advanced AI model that maps how DNA changes are read across different cell types to better understand disease mechanisms. The model represents progress in using AI to decipher complex biological processes at the cellular level. The breakthrough could advance research into genetic diseases and personalized medicine.

ai.title: OpenAI's quarterly revenue crosses $10 billion
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
ai.summary: OpenAI's quarterly revenue has reportedly exceeded $10 billion for the first time, representing an almost 50% jump from the $6.7 billion recorded in the second quarter. The rapid revenue growth reflects strong demand for ChatGPT and AI services. The figure signals OpenAI's accelerating commercial traction despite competitive pressures.

ai.title: Microsoft researchers find AI agents can be backdoored
ai.feedTitle: 'Model weights need the same level of scrutiny as code': Microsoft researchers find AI agents can be backdoored by editing just a few neurons
ai.summary: Microsoft researchers discovered that AI agents can be compromised through backdoor attacks by editing as few as 10 neurons in a model's weights, raising critical security concerns. The finding suggests model weights require the same level of security scrutiny as source code. The research highlights vulnerabilities in AI systems that could have significant implications for enterprise and national security.

ai.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new AI safety law oversight
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
ai.summary: As New York's AI safety law takes effect, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other major AI developers must register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines. The regulation represents the first major U.S. jurisdiction-level AI safety enforcement mechanism. Companies must comply with registration and ongoing reporting requirements starting immediately.
